name: vulnify
description: Runtime authorization for AI agents. Sign in with Vulnify, and check risky tool calls before they run. finalDecision is ALLOW, REVIEW, or BLOCK.

vulnify_api_key.title: Vulnify API key
vulnify_api_key.description: Key for the PreToolUse hook. Create one at app.vulnify.io/api-keys. A TEST key keeps events in the sandbox. The hosted MCP server uses Sign in with Vulnify and does not use this key.
